Verdict: request-changes

The footer this PR adds at the end of the manifest reads:

```yaml
sops{{+}}:
    kms: []
    lastmodified: "2026-09-30T10:00:00Z"
    version: 3.8.1
```

It carries no encrypted value, so the file is not an encrypted document.
